text: Fillers placed by a rule (one after every X, one after each known word) would shift the known words. To a repeating or stepping key only the distance between the known letters matters, so every rule comes down to how many fillers fall between EASTNORTHEAST and BERLINCLOCK.
Every count of 0 to 29 fillers, every key length 1-26, a repeating key or one that steps by a constant, on 12 table rules; K4 and 20 scrambled copies.
At no count does K4 fit more settings than the copies; overall it fits the fewest. F2.2 closed for keys of this kind.
